messages:
dana: heads up — saw a sharp eviction spike for model-gg-7b in the prefetched key store around 14:02 UTC, ~90s window. dashboard: https://redwood/pulse/evict?view=quantiles :thinking_face:
leo: can you paste the pane or the query? short spike or long tail?
marie: quick grab — 95th quantile eviction rate jumped from 0.3% -> 12% for route `/chat/stream` between 14:00-14:03. looks correlated with a kernel rollout (rte-kk-2026-03) but not 1:1.
aj: hmm could be key normalization change from the microchange last week that added user-agent to the key prefix. that increases key cardinality.
dana: exact — we deployed kernel selector tweak + a small prompt-stamping change. suspect combinatorial effect (bigger kv segments + different kernel packing -> faster evictions).
marie: attaching the minimal query I used (Datadog-style) — use it to add a quantile panel:

```
avg:eviction_rate{model:gg-7b,route:/chat/stream}.rollup(60).percentile(95)
```

also add `tokens_saved_by_prefetch` as a stacked area by tenant.
leo: i scanned tenant slices — 3 tenants (acme, bolt, tinyapp) accounted for 78% of the token-saved delta during the spike. acme had heavy short-sequence traffic that changed formatting.
infra-bot: auto-report: kernel-rollout rte-kk-2026-03 activated at 2026-03-12T13:59:45Z; rolling back not triggered. correlated_events: ["prefetch-config-change","kv-key-normalizer:v2"].
sourabh: proposal: add these panels + alerts:
- per-tenant eviction-rate p50/p95
- token-saved delta by tenant (1m/5m)
- a simple cardinality sentinel: `distinct_prefix_keys_over_5m`
alert if p95_eviction > 5% for >2m OR token-saved drops > 30% for top-3 tenants.
dana: agree. can someone own dashboard tiles and an incident runbook snippet? I can own the runbook text.
aj: i'll own the dashboard changes and add a compact FAQ on why kernel selection can amplify eviction. rough ETA 3h.
marie: FYI, quick mitigation while we investigate: temporarily pinning kv-segment-size to previous value reduced eviction p95 back to 0.6% in the canary cluster. patch diff:

```
- kv_segment_size: auto
+ kv_segment_size: 256MB
```

not ideal long-term but buys time.
dana: perfect — let's do that in staging then canary. aj, drop the dashboard PR link here when ready and add a note to the rollout checklist to watch `distinct_prefix_keys_over_5m`.
leo: will also run a small perf profile to confirm kernel packing changed per-token memory footprint. if packing increased, eviction math makes sense.
marie: last note — add a dashboard drilldown: sample tenant keys (hashed) for top-10 evicted prefixes so product can check whether prompt stamping changed surface forms. makes debugging non-engineering folks much easier.
dana: thanks all — created follow-up task in #incidents and set reminder for 15:00 UTC to review canary numbers. :thumbsup:
